pair.title: Pair With Your Computer
pair.intro: Your phone is the microphone. Handy on your computer does the transcribing.
pair.step1: Open Handy on your computer and go to Mobile.
pair.step2: Turn on Handy Mobile and choose Pair a Phone.
pair.step3: Scan the code it shows. Both devices must be on the same network.
pair.manualPlaceholder: Paste the pairing code from your computer
pair.scanHint: Point the camera at the code on your computer

errors.invalid_code: That isn't a Handy pairing code.
errors.expired_code: That code has expired or was already used. Create a new one on your computer.
errors.incompatible: This app and Handy on your computer are too far apart in version. Update both.
errors.rate_limited: Too many attempts. Wait a minute, then try again.
errors.unreachable: Your computer can't be reached. Make sure both devices are on the same network, that a firewall isn't blocking Handy, and that Handy Mobile is allowed to find nearby devices in your phone's settings.
errors.untrusted: Something answered that isn't your computer. Create a new code and try again.
errors.camera_denied: Handy Mobile needs the camera to scan the code. Allow it in your phone's settings, or enter the code instead.
errors.scan_failed: The camera couldn't be started. Enter the code instead.

link.offlineHint: Make sure Handy is running on {{name}}, both devices are on the same network, and Handy Mobile is allowed to find nearby devices in your phone's settings.
link.rejected: This phone is no longer paired with {{name}}.
link.incompatible: This app and Handy on {{name}} are too far apart in version. Update both.

output.label: Send text to
output.desktopHint: Typed where the cursor is on {{name}}.
output.phoneHint: Shown here and copied to the clipboard.

notices.micDenied: Handy Mobile needs the microphone. Allow it in your phone's settings.
notices.connectionLost: The connection dropped, so that recording wasn't transcribed.
notices.busy: Your computer is busy with another dictation.
notices.no_model: Handy on your computer has no model selected.
notices.paste_failed: Your computer couldn't type the text, so it's only here.
notices.too_long: That reached the length limit, so it was finished for you.
notices.generic: Something went wrong on your computer.

settings.title: Settings
settings.unpairConfirm: Unpair from {{name}}? You'll need to scan a new code to dictate again.
settings.unpairNote: To remove this phone from the list on your computer as well, unpair it there in Mobile settings.

keyboard.title: Dictate Into Any App
keyboard.intro: Handy Mobile is also a keyboard. Switch to it wherever you type, tap the microphone, and what you say is transcribed on your computer and typed into the text field on your phone.

microphone.title: Allow the Microphone
microphone.description: So the keyboard can hear you. Choose "While using the app"; "Only this time" wears off.

localNetwork.title: Allow Nearby Devices
localNetwork.description: So your phone can reach your computer on your network.

enable.title: Turn On the Handy Keyboard
enable.description: Switch on Handy Mobile in the list that opens and confirm both of Android's prompts, then come back here. Android warns that a keyboard can collect what you type. Handy's keyboard sends only your voice, and only to your own computer.

select.title: Switch to the Handy Keyboard
select.description: Choose Handy Mobile in the list of keyboards.

keyboard.tryPlaceholder: Tap here, then tap the microphone
keyboard.switchHint: The keyboard button on the Handy keyboard takes you back to your usual keyboard. To switch to Handy from another keyboard, use its keyboard or globe button.
